description_en: Creates a remediation for an existing rule
kebab_example: aliyun config create-remediation --config-rule-id cr-8a973ac2e2be00a20000 --remediation-type OOS --remediation-template-id ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl --invoke-type MANUAL_EXECUTION --source-type ALIYUN --params bucketName_:_resourceId_,_regionId_:_regionId_,_permissionName_:_private --client-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:
The type of the remediation. Valid values:

- OOS: template-based remediation using OOS.

- FC: custom remediation using FC.
parameters.description_zh:
修正类型。取值：

- OOS：运维编排（模板修正）。
- FC：函数计算（自定义修正）。

parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the remediation template.

- If `RemediationType` is set to `OOS`, set this parameter to `ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`. For more information, see [ListRemediationTemplates](~~416781~~).

- If `RemediationType` is set to `FC`, set this parameter to the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function in Function Compute. Example: `acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`.
parameters.description_zh:
修正模板ID。

- 当`RemediationType`为`OOS`时，该参数为`ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`。关于如何获取修正模板ID，请参见[ListRemediationTemplates](~~416781~~)。

- 当`RemediationType`为`FC`时，该参数为函数计算的ARN，例如：`acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`。

parameters.description_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:

- NON\_EXECUTION: The remediation is not executed.

- AUTO\_EXECUTION: The remediation is automatically executed.

- MANUAL\_EXECUTION: The remediation is manually executed.

- NOT\_CONFIG: The execution mode is not set.
parameters.description_zh:

- NOT_CONFIG：未设置。

parameters.description_en:
The source of the remediation template. Valid values:

- ALIYUN (default): an official template.

- CUSTOM: a custom template. This value is required for custom FC remediations.

- NONE: no source.
parameters.description_zh:

- ALIYUN（默认值）：官方模板。
- CUSTOM：自定义模板。（自定义FC修正时需要填写此值）
- NONE：无。
